title: Generate Parentheses
description:
# Generate Parentheses

Given `n` pairs of parentheses, write a function to *generate all combinations of well-formed parentheses*.

## Example 1:

**Input:** n = 3
**Output:** ["((()))","(()())","(())()","()(())","()()()"]

## Example 2:

**Input:** n = 1
**Output:** ["()"]

## Constraints:

*   `1 <= n <= 8`

solutions.name: Backtracking
solutions.description: Recursively build valid combinations. Add '(' if open count < n, add ')' if close count < open count.

solutions.name: Backtracking with String
solutions.description: Same backtracking approach but using string concatenation (simpler but slightly less efficient).

solutions.name: Dynamic Programming
solutions.description: Build solutions for n using solutions for smaller values. dp[n] = '(' + dp[i] + ')' + dp[n-1-i] for all i.
